rationale: handlePreferencesRequest in src/server.js does call _.defaultsDeep() on attacker-controlled input (req.body.preferences), so the vulnerable code path IS reached. However, sanitize() runs first and strips any __proto__/constructor/prototype key at any depth, which is exactly the payload shape CVE-2019-10744 requires. The vulnerable function is reachable but the exploitation precondition cannot be satisfied through this endpoint.

authoritative_evidence.detail: handlePreferencesRequest calls sanitize(req.body.preferences) before passing the result into _.defaultsDeep().
sanitize() recursively removes __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys at every depth of the input.
